tools.name: link_account
tools.description: Links this agent to the person's account. Returns a link where the person signs in and approves a short code; call again once they have. Never ask for a password.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: The ways to pay for hosting, with prices, and the account's current plan. The first space is a free private preview, so show them when the person wants to publish it or keep it.

tools.name: create_space
tools.description: Creates a space for one capture. An account that does not pay for hosting yet gets its first space as a free private preview: upload and process it with no payment. After that, it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the plan the person chose (pay as you go when none is given) for them to pay; then ca

tools.name: wait_for_payment
tools.description: Waits up to 25 seconds for the person to finish paying in Stripe Checkout, whether for a space's first payment or to publish a free preview. Call it again to keep waiting.

tools.name: upload_files
tools.description: Starts resumable uploads for capture files you hold (for example photos or video the person shared with you) and returns where to PUT each file's bytes. For files on the person's own device, give them the space's page to drop the files instead.

tools.name: finish_upload
tools.description: Checks that every uploaded file is complete and submits the space for processing. The account is emailed when the space is ready.

tools.name: space_status
tools.description: Status of one space, or every space on the account with its link when ready.

tools.name: set_visibility
tools.description: Makes a ready space public (anyone with the link) or private (only the owner). Ask the person first. A free preview cannot be public until hosting starts, so it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the person to pay.

tools.name: unlink_account
tools.description: Unlinks this agent from the account.

tools.name: find_tour_spaces
tools.description: Spaces a guided tour or scavenger hunt can be built on: the person's own finished spaces and the site's public spaces (museums, temples, tombs, gardens). Search by words in the title.

tools.name: list_tours
tools.description: The tours and scavenger hunts on the account, with their links.

tools.name: create_tour
tools.description: Starts a private guided tour or scavenger hunt on a space from find_tour_spaces; fill it with draft_tour or save_tour.

tools.name: draft_tour
tools.description: Asks the site's tour agent, which sees the space's photographs, to write or rework the tour from a plain request: stops and text, hidden objects and clues, library models, effects, sound, music, looks with transitions and skies (day, sunset, storm, night, stars). It places everything and saves. Retu

tools.name: wait_for_tour
tools.description: Waits up to 25 seconds for a draft to finish, then summarizes the tour. Call it again to keep waiting.

tools.name: get_tour
tools.description: The tour as JSON (stops, objects, effects, looks, skies) with its revision, for editing with save_tour.

tools.name: save_tour
tools.description: Saves a tour edited by hand: the experience JSON from get_tour with changes. Models use a url from search_models, or any https address of a .glb.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Searches the library of ready-made 3D models (statues, amphorae, temples, furniture, animals, props from many periods). Returns each model's size and url.

tools.name: share_tour
tools.description: Makes a tour public (anyone with its link, never listed) or private, and optionally renames it. Ask the person first.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "link_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_models · Private data: link_account, list_plans, create_space, upload_files, finish_upload, set_visibility, create_tour, share_tour · Public sink: list_plans, create_space, wait_for_payment, upload_files, finish_upload, share_tour · Destructive: upload_files.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_models · Private data: link_account, list_plans, create_space, upload_files, finish_upload, set_visibility, create_tour, share_tour · Public sink: list_plans, create_space, wait_for_payment, upload_files, finish_upload, share_tour · Destructive: upload_files

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
